patterns.reminder: git-reviewer sandbox rule: containers run with --network=none, non-root, read-only, all capabilities dropped and no mounts except the read-only temp worktree. This flag weakens the sandbox (SECURITY.md T-09 to T-11).
git-reviewer rule: child processes get a minimal explicit environment built in proc.py, never the user's environment (SECURITY.md T-11, T-22).
shutil.copytree follows symlinks by default and can copy files from outside the repository (e.g. ~/.ssh). Pass symlinks=True and validate link targets (SECURITY.md T-18).
git-reviewer rule: LangChain/LangSmith tracing must be forced off before any LangChain import and never enabled (SECURITY.md T-25).
git-reviewer rule: model output is validated with strict Pydantic (strict=True, extra='forbid') and rejected if invalid, never repaired (SECURITY.md T-04).
git-reviewer rule: the tool never commits or pushes, and never uses git apply --unsafe-paths (SECURITY.md T-18, T-20).
git-reviewer only talks to a loopback Ollama. 0.0.0.0 may only appear in the check that warns when Ollama listens on all interfaces (SECURITY.md T-24).
